stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 全周期巩固第 110 天预定间隔复习词群，强化多义辨析与跨场景（AI/时序/具身智能论文、演讲、六级/雅思托福）主动写作。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G002】可数名词、不可数名词及多义词在不同义项下的可数性切换；【G007】时态、体与学术论文各章节的方法论时间分工。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP014】使用 respectively 与平行结构实现高密度信息配对，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 可数名词、不可数名词及多义词在不同义项下的可数性切换
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 不仅要区分绝对不可数名词（evidence, information, research, literature, equipment, apparatus, documentation, feedback, knowledge）与可数名词（study, finding, discrepancy, anomaly, covariate），更要掌握“同一单词在不同词义下的可数性切换”（Rule A.2）。
rules: 不可数学术名词不加 a/an 或复数 -s（严禁写 *an evidence, *researches, *equipments, *feedbacks）；表单项用 a piece/item of evidence, a research study, a piece of equipment。
一词多义下的可数性切换：discipline 表“纪律”不可数，表“学科”可数（two academic disciplines）；work 表“研究工作”不可数，workings 表“计算步骤”；experience 表“经验”不可数，表“经历”可数（experiences in childhood）；paper 表“纸”不可数，表“论文”可数。
量词精确匹配：修饰不可数用 a great deal of, a large amount of, much, less and less；修饰可数复数用 a large number of, a handful of, many, fewer and fewer。
examples: The transcription required a great deal of effort.
A large number of records still require checking.
The project draws on two academic disciplines.
All apparatus was checked before the experiment.
common_errors: 量词与可数性错配：*a great deal of participants / *an amount of respondents / *fewer time。
不可数名词误加复数：*many evidences / *new equipments / *useful feedbacks。

grammar_instruction.name: 时态、体与学术论文各章节的方法论时间分工
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 学术论文的时态传递方法论状态：一般过去时描述本研究特定实验步骤与过去采样结果；一般现在时描述数学定义、图表展示内容、模型架构属性及本文篇章导引；现在完成时总结某领域迄今的研究演进或前文已完成论证。
rules: 描述本研究特定数据集采集、预处理步骤与单次实验观测用一般过去时（The team abandoned the approach; Two analysts analysed the data independently）。
描述数学性质、算法机制、图表内容及普遍事实用一般现在时（The affine function f(x) = ax + b includes an intercept b; Table 1 shows...）。
描述近十年研究趋势或前文已展现的内容用现在完成时（The field has developed in recent years; As we have seen, the two estimates use different denominators）。
examples: The team accessed the database before the policy changed.
A weakly stationary process has a constant finite mean and autocovariance that depends only on the lag.
As has been shown in Table 2, attendance varied by site.
common_errors: 把尚未开展的 Future Work 写成已完成的一般过去时。
在明确过去时间状语（during the pilot）下误用现在完成时。

grammar_instruction.name: 近义词与多义词深度辨析：语义范围、褒贬色彩、技术定义与语域
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 区分近义词与一词多义在语义范围、判断强度、褒贬色彩及学科专有定义上的差别。禁止把仅有部分重合的词当作完全同义词替换，禁止为堆砌大词而改变事实或判断强度。
rules: 测量与统计核心辨析：accuracy（准确度，接近真值） vs precision（精密度，重复测量一致）；reliable（稳定一致） vs valid（有效测量目标构念或推理成立）；efficacy（受控试验效力） vs effectiveness（真实场景效果）；equal（均等） vs equitable（按需求公平分配）；seasonality（固定日历周期） vs cyclicality（非固定周期的波动）；isotonic（保序的/等渗的） vs isotropic（各向同性的）。
褒贬与语域辨析：simple（简明清晰的） vs simplistic（过度简化的，贬义）；exploit structure（中性：利用结构） vs exploit workers（贬义：剥削）；manipulate a variable（中性：实验操纵自变量） vs falsify data（贬义：伪造数据）。
examples: An equitable allocation of resources may differ from an equal allocation.
Business cyclicality may involve expansions and contractions of varying duration, whereas seasonality follows a fixed calendar period.
An isotropic covariance function depends on distance rather than direction, whereas isotonic regression enforces a monotonicity constraint.
common_errors: 把 suggest/indicate 机械替换为 prove/demonstrate 导致过度推断。
混淆形近学术词：adapt/adopt, adverse/averse, discrete/discreet, temporal/temporary, stationary/stationery, isotonic/isotropic。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 使用 respectively 与平行结构实现高密度信息配对
expression_pattern_instruction.template: [Symbol/Group A] and [Symbol/Group B] denote/represent [Entity X] and [Entity Y], respectively.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 在不增加从句负担的前提下清晰交代多组符号或实验参数的一一对应关系。
examples: The symbols x and y denote temperature and demand, respectively.
The slope and intercept of f(x) = ax + b are a and b, respectively.
common_errors: 前后序列元素数量不匹配或顺序颠倒。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 坦诚说明研究局限与外推风险（Limitations & Extrapolation）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: We acknowledge that [dataset/simulation limitation]; therefore, one should not extrapolate these findings to [unseen regime] without further validation.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于论文 Limitations 小节，体现成熟严谨的科学态度。
examples: The authors acknowledge that the sample excludes rural clinics.
We should not extrapolate from a single district to the entire country without justification.
common_errors: 用空洞借口掩盖核心样本偏差。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：用范围和限定避免绝对化。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The records indicate a tendency towards shorter visits.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：名词influence后用on引出受影响对象，如the influence of A on B。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The analysis considers the policy’s influence on behaviour.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：同意基于知晓研究内容；不等于一般许可。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The researchers obtained informed consent before the interviews.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：initial 表示起初，不表示已验证。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：inquiry为名词，into引出调查或探究的对象。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The inquiry into missing records is ongoing.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：insight into表示对问题的深入理解；into引出所理解的对象。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Interviews provided insights into residents’ concerns.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：insights为复数，表示多项认识或理解；仍接into。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The interviews provide insights into residents’ experiences.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：integral to；an integral part of。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Independent checking is integral to the procedure.

scheduled_review_words.meaning_zh: 在思想或学术上独立的
scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：independent of other disciplines。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The essay asks whether disciplines are intellectually independent.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：interlibrary 拼法也通用。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The researcher requested the book through an inter-library loan.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：不能从教材推定现行贷款利率。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The agreement specifies a fixed interest rate.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：overdraft 与 loan 不同；不能据例句当作现行产品建议。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：with 后接受到干扰的过程或对象。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The observation schedule should not interfere with normal teaching.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：解释与数据记录区分。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: We interpret the data cautiously because several values are missing.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：investigation为名词，into引出被调查的问题或事件。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The report presents an investigation into missing records.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：of引出所讨论的议题，如the issue of informed consent。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The discussion addresses the issue of informed consent.
